articles.title: Citi Names Top Application Software Stocks After Q3 Results
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Citi has updated its rankings for back office application software stocks following third-quarter results, prioritizing companies with clear acceleration potential and differentiated AI strategies. The firm continues to favor names with infrastructure-like or regulatory-driven value propositions while expressing caution on small and medium-sized business-exposed vendors facing top-of-funnel headwinds. BOX, NAVN, and ROP emerged as the top three picks in the updated rankings.
